name: Climate.Pid → Set Deadband Control Parameters Multipliers
description: This action sets runtime multipliers for the deadband PID terms. This can be used to manually tune the PID controller deadband parameters. Make sure to update the values you want in the YAML file! They will reset on the next reboot.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: ID of the PID Climate to update.

config_entries.label: Kp Multiplier
config_entries.description: Deadband multiplier for the proportional term.

config_entries.label: Kd Multiplier
config_entries.description: Deadband multiplier for the derivative term. If omitted, the current multiplier is kept.

config_entries.label: Ki Multiplier
config_entries.description: Deadband multiplier for the integral term. If omitted, the current multiplier is kept.
